# Select

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Select expression
Case value1, value2
statements
Default
statements
End Select
```

## Description

Compares one expression with the values of each [Case](Case), from the top, and runs the statements of the first case that matches. The statements of other cases are skipped, with no fall through. The optional [Default](Default) must be last and runs when no case matched. The block ends with `End Select`. The expression can be a string, in which case the case values are strings too.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Function Name$(n)
	Select n
		Case 1 : Return "one"
		Case 2, 3 : Return "two or three"
		Default : Return "other"
	End Select
End Function

Print Name$(1)
Print Name$(3)
Print Name$(9)
```

```text
one
two or three
other
```
